privacyPolicyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicyPage.overviewBody: This Privacy Policy explains how {{appName}} ("we", "us", "our") collects, uses, and protects information when you use our web application and related services (the "Service").
privacyPolicyPage.accountP: When you register or log in, we may collect details such as username, email, name, phone number, and account type.
privacyPolicyPage.filesP: When you upload or manage content, we may process files/images and associated metadata needed to provide storage, sharing, and gallery features (for example: filenames, sizes, timestamps, and identifiers).
privacyPolicyPage.billingP: If you purchase a plan, we may process subscription and payment-related details (for example: plan selected, billing cycle, and payment status). Sensitive payment details are typically handled by the payment processor.
privacyPolicyPage.usageP: We may collect basic usage and diagnostics information (such as pages visited, feature usage, and error logs) to improve reliability and security.
privacyPolicyPage.useLi1: Provide and operate the Service (authentication, uploads, viewing, sharing, and account features)
privacyPolicyPage.useLi2: Maintain safety and prevent abuse, fraud, and unauthorized access
privacyPolicyPage.useLi3: Support billing/subscriptions (if applicable) and customer support
privacyPolicyPage.useLi4: Improve performance, usability, and feature quality
privacyPolicyPage.shareP: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information only as necessary to provide the Service (for example, with cloud storage or payment providers), to comply with legal obligations, or to protect users and the Service from harm.
privacyPolicyPage.securityP: We take reasonable measures to protect your data. However, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure. Please use strong passwords and keep your credentials confidential.
privacyPolicyPage.retentionP: We retain information for as long as needed to provide the Service and comply with legal obligations. You may request deletion of your account data, subject to applicable laws and operational requirements.
privacyPolicyPage.choicesLi1: Access and update your profile information within the Service (where available)
privacyPolicyPage.choicesLi2: Log out and manage device/browser access
privacyPolicyPage.choicesLi3: Request account deletion by contacting us
privacyPolicyPage.childrenP: The Service is not intended for children under 13. If you believe a child has provided personal information, contact us so we can delete it.
privacyPolicyPage.changesP: We may update this policy from time to time. We will post the updated version in the app with a revised effective date.
privacyPolicyPage.contactP: For privacy questions or requests, contact us at {{email}}.
privacyPolicyPage.footerTip: Tip: You can bookmark this page at /privacy-policy.
